name: perspective-marquee
description: A 3D tilted marquee with depth feel as items roll toward the horizon.

vars.description: How far the marquee plane leans back toward the horizon.
Scales the offset the timeline drives, so the strip covers a shorter or longer run in the same time.
Pill colour: ink for light frames, paper for dark ones, accent rides the brand token.
Comma separated pill labels. The list is laid down twice so the strip still reads as a continuous loop.
